question.text: The stability of Me $\mathcal{C}=\mathrm{CH}_{2}$ is more than that of $\mathrm{MeCH}_{2} \mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}_{2}$ due to

options.text: inductive effect of the Me groups
resonance effect of the Me groups
hyperconjugative effect of the Me groups
resonance as well as inductive effect of the Me groups

solution.text: 2-hyperconltjugate forms. Therefore, $\mathrm{Me} \underline{\mathcal{C}}=\mathrm{CH}_{2}$ is more stable than $\mathrm{MeCH}_{2} \mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}_{2}$
